name: dotnet-cli
title: .NET CLI
blurb: .NET 8 C# CLI: pure counting core, hand-written argv parser, xUnit suite, exit codes as a contract

verify.name: word-count
verify.cmd: printf 'one two\nthree\n' > sample.txt && dotnet bin/Debug/net8.0/{{ npm_name }}.dll sample.txt | grep -Eq '^ *2 +3 +14 +sample\.txt$'

verify.name: parity
verify.cmd:
printf 'alpha beta
gamma delta
' > .p1.txt && printf 'no trailing newline' > .p2.txt && printf 'h\303\251llo w\303\266rld
' > .p3.txt && : > .p4.txt && for f in .p1.txt .p2.txt .p3.txt .p4.txt; do ours=$(dotnet bin/Debug/net8.0/{{ npm_name }}.dll -l -w -c "$f" | awk '{print $1, $2, $3}'); theirs=$(wc -l -w -c "$f" | awk '{print $1, $2, $3}'); if [ "$ours" != "$theirs" ]; then echo "MISMATCH $f: ours=[$ours] theirs=[$theirs]"; exit 1; fi; done && rm -f .p1.txt .p2.txt .p3.txt .p4.txt && echo "parity ok"
